title: Capital Automotive Financial (CAF) Launches Platform to Invest in Automotive Retail Industry
主要内容: Capital Automotive Financial (CAF) launched a new company to provide long-term equity capital solutions to leading dealers, chief operating officers, and general managers in the retail automotive industry. The initiative is led by Richard Kotzen, an automotive industry veteran, and is anchored by an investment from Two Sigma Private Investments (TSPI). CAF's flexible capital base will offer financing structures, either in minority or majority positions, that could lead to full ownership of retail dealership platforms over time. The company aims to help dealers maximize profitability and growth potential through its industry expertise and operational capabilities. CAF also launched a platform called CARS to invest in the automotive retail industry, providing tailored real estate finance to assist dealers in growing their organizations, acquiring new locations, upgrading existing facilities, constructing new stores, and facilitating estate planning and partner buyouts. CARS was created through collaboration between automobile dealers and experts in real estate and finance. Brookfield Property Partners, which owns Capital Automotive since October 2014, is one of the world's largest commercial real estate companies with over $66 billion in total assets.
